name: How much does an ADU bathroom cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to build a full ADU bathroom in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, or North Hollywood?
mainEntity.text: What is the typical cost to build a full ADU bathroom in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, or North Hollywood?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an ADU bathroom in Los Angeles usually depends less on the fixture package and more on the plumbing path. A bathroom placed near existing water, drain, and vent lines is far more affordable than one that requires trenching, foundation cuts, or new sewer work. Other major cost drivers include waterproofing, tile scope, ventilation, electrical upgrades, permit submittals, and whether the bathroom is part of a garage conversion, detached new build, or addition. Luxury finishes can raise the budget quickly, but hidden conditions often matter even more than finishes. When comparing bids, ask contractors to separate plumbing, waterproofing, fixtures, tile, and permit fees so the estimate is easier to compare. For homeowners in Los Angeles-area cities, it is also smart to ask what is included for inspections, drain testing, and finish allowances. A low bid can hide expensive change orders if the bathroom location or sewer connection is not fully solved in the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical ADU bathroom in Los Angeles can range widely depending on whether it is a simple new bath, a remodel of existing space, or a full plumbing run from scratch. Cost increases when the project needs new drains, a long sewer tie-in, upgraded waterproofing, or premium finishes. In many cases, plumbing and permitting drive the biggest price swings.
